multi-area-disc.reason: The core picks among the disc's areas by its own preference order.
multi-area-disc.title: Disc listing several areas

saturn-disc-database.reason: The core's own database decides the area, so a header read is not enough without that table.
saturn-disc-database.title: A disc or cartridge database overrides the header

saturn-kr-ipl.reason: The KR IPL is not declared by the profile, so the core falls back to a region-free image, then a mismatched one.
saturn-kr-ipl.title: Asia NTSC and Korea discs ask for an undeclared IPL

user-region-option.reason: The forced region decides the file, and the option is device state the installer does not read.
user-region-option.title: A core option forces the console region

beetle_saturn.note: B is the SMPC area Central/South America NTSC ('Brazil' in the table), L Central/South America PAL.
beetle_saturn.overridden_by: a disc-id database (mednafen/ss/db.c) that can force the area of a listed disc, then the beetle_saturn_region option when not Auto Detect

kronos.note: The first of kronos/saturn_bios.bin, saturn_bios.bin, sega_101.bin, mpr-17933.bin found serves every disc.

mednafen_stv.overridden_by: the mednafen_stv_region option when not auto. Its disc database is empty in this fork.

saturn-area.description: Sector 0 starts with 'SEGA SEGASATURN '. The 16 bytes at 0x40 hold area symbols. Each letter adds its area, and the core picks the first area of its own preference order the disc lists.

licence.quote: Dumpers only submit metadata and Redump only stores metadata. This information is considered public domain to be used however people see fit

sources.serial_note: Serials are written as the DAT writes them, and the DAT uses both forms: 'SLES-01971' and 'SLPS 02251' in the PlayStation DAT of the same day. A core reads the serial from the disc in its own spelling (SYSTEM.CNF holds 'SLPS_022.51', DuckStation reports 'SLPS-02251'). No source fixes a rule joining the two, so the comparison rule is the reader's to state.

keep_all_regions.when: the disc lists more than one area, picked by a user-configurable order
